text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SLO breach detected for /v1/generate (p99 > 3000ms) across us-west-2. Auto-page to oncall-sre at 4020001111.

oncall-sre: acknowledging, joining. What metrics do we have?

tara: seeing p95 ~1200ms, p99 ~4.8s for streaming requests; spike started ~4020001000. Error rates are stable but tail latency jumped.

mohit: looks correlated with a bump in preproc CPU on preproc-1/2 (tokenizer). CPU @ 95% and occasional OOM-kill retries on the json-mode workers.

lucy: customer-impact: CS reports two customers saw streaming stalls and reconnects; one timed out after 20s. Ticket #CS-4859 opened.

eng-ml: initial hypothesis: recent prompt-template change that enabled tool-schema assembly + JSON mode increased prompt-construction cost, causing long preproc durations and blocking kv-cache warm paths.

oncall-sre: can we confirm which commits/deploys went out?

infra-bot: deploy-bot: deploy finished: commit 1f7a3b -> canary -> prod at 4020000920 by @mohit.

mohit: yep, that canary included a change to template expansion to support nested tool schemas for streaming. I rolled it to prod.

tara: attaching quick profiler snapshot: ``
# preproc latencies (ms)
sample: [45, 90, 1200, 4800, 5200]
median ~85ms, p95 ~1200ms, p99 ~4800ms
worker: preproc-json-0
queue-depth spike ~180
``

lucy: CS: affected customers are chat-heavy (long toolchain prompts), started at 10:03 PDT, intermittent reconnects. Severity elevated to Sev2.

oncall-sre: immediate mitigation plan: 1) revert template expansion commit on prod canary -> roll back fully 2) scale preproc JSON workers by +30% 3) enable request-level fallback to non-json-mode for streaming if timeout > 2s.

mohit: I'm prepping rollback PR now. Rolling to canary first; ETA ~5m.

eng-ml: while rollback goes, can we route new requests to dedicated non-json path? We have a compatibility flag `X-Prefer-Json=false` we can inject via the router policy. That avoids a full rollback if quick switch needed.

oncall-sre: @infra-bot can we create a temporary routing rule?

infra-bot: routing-bot: rule created: route header X-Prefer-Json=false for 25% of traffic to fallback pool (non-json-preproc) at 4020001180.

tara: after routing 25% we see p99 in fallback pool ~900ms, main still at ~3.8s.

mohit: canary rollback applied at 4020001200. Metrics show improvement in canary shard immediately.

eng-ml: note: significant part of cost from tokenizer paging during prompt expansion. When tool-schema contains nested arrays, we re-run tokenization per tool entry. That's O(n^2) in worst cases.

lucy: CS: confirmed reconnects stopped for the customers routed to fallback. One customer still hit a stall before their session ended.

oncall-sre: scaling preproc pool now (+3 instances).

infra-bot: autoscale: provisioned 3 preproc-json nodes at 4020001225. CPU dropped from 95% -> 70% but tail still high on main pool.

mohit: full rollback merged and promoted to prod at 4020001250. Observability: p99 dropped to ~700ms across regions.

tara: streaming stalls reduced, but we still see p95 elevated for a subset of long-toolchain requests (lengthy templates with many tool schemas). Investigating prompt-constructor logs.

eng-ml: found a hotspot: function assembleToolCalls() does repeated tokenization of identical snippets because of missing memoization in the new code path. Patch ready: add cache keyed by template-hash + schema-id.

mohit: will ship hotfix (non-breaking) to add memoization to assembleToolCalls, target deploy 4020001500 if we get buy-in.

oncall-sre: agreed. Hotfix approved. In meantime, keep routing rule at 25% until hotfix is live.

lucy: CS: customers routed to fallback report normal behavior. We'll communicate status update: mitigation in place, rollback complete, hotfix planned.

eng-ml: also recommend adding guardrail: if assembled prompt token count > 8k, abort JSON-mode assembly and fall back to streaming-simple mode. That prevents worst-case O(n^2) expansions.

tara: metrics action items: create dashboard for prompt-constructor latency, instrument template-hash cache hit rate, and add alert if preproc queue depth > 100 for 1m.

oncall-sre: postmortem notes in thread: root cause = template expansion change enabling nested tool-schema assembly + missing memoization -> heavy repeated tokenization -> preproc CPU saturation -> streaming tail latency. Customer impact: 2 customers with reconnects, 1 timed out.

mohit: hotfix deploy started at 4020001480, promoting to canary.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: hotfix canary success. Promoting to prod at 4020001495.

tara: prod hotfix active at 4020001505. p95 ~220ms, p99 ~650ms, streaming stalls gone in observed windows.

lucy: CS: posting update to affected customers. Keeping ticket open until 24h stable.

eng-ml: follow-ups: add unit tests for nested tool-schema cases, add memoization, add guardrail thresholds, and run load-test for long template scenarios.

oncall-sre: closing page at 4020001600. Will create incident record and schedule RCA meeting tomorrow. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident closed for SLO breach after mitigations at 4020001600 (duration ~8m).
